rules.name: Clear material-connection disclosure
rules.summary: Clearly disclose the creator's material connection. Make CHANEL's sponsorship identifiable when multiple brands appear. Do not rely on labels the guide identifies as insufficient.

rules.name: Disclosure placement in each content surface
rules.summary: Place disclosure near the endorsement and at the start/above the fold. For video, account for the spoken and visible endorsement in the corresponding script fields. A text prototype cannot verify actual prominence, duration, or audibility.

rules.name: No misleading impartiality in competitor criticism
rules.summary: A creator connected to CHANEL should not imply an impartial opinion when criticizing a competitor. A neutral competitor mention alone is not a breach under this rule.

rules.name: First-hand opinion and factual-claim evidence
rules.summary: Endorsements of opinions require first-hand product use. Factual product claims should be supportable and verifiable. The prototype routes unverifiable claims to a human reviewer rather than declaring them false.
